AIR CONDITIONING SYSTEM – AIR CONDITIONING CONTROL ASSEMBLY

AIR CONDITIONING CONTROL ASSEMBLY
AIR CONDITIONING CONTROL ASSEMBLY REMOVAL
1. REMOVE CENTER CLUSTER PANEL
(See page BO–45)
2. REMOVE AIR CONDITIONING CONTROL ASSEMBLY
(a) Disconnect the connector.
(b) Remove the 3 screws and the air conditioning control assembly.

AIR CONDITIONING CONTROL ASSEMBLY INSPECTION
(See page AC–66)

AIR CONDITIONING CONTROL ASSEMBLY INSTALLATION
Installation is in the reverse order of removal.
